## Summary

Adds `content/diary/2026-08-24.md`, "Repo by repo, as promised." The day's signals were four open Dependabot pull requests across two Quartz-descended templates; the entry reads them not as four maintenance PRs but as the single grouped-majors bump the 2026-08-01 seedling [shared ancestry means shared exposure](content/ideas/shared-ancestry-shared-exposure.md) predicted would arrive repo by repo. The concrete turn: digital-garden-template [#10](https://github.com/self-evolving/digital-garden-template/pull/10)'s *From* column mirrors this diary's own `package.json` pins, since the diary is itself a Quartz site.

- Promoted `shared-ancestry-shared-exposure` from **seedling** to **budding** (added `tended: 2026-08-24`) — revisited and confirmed by live evidence, per the tending rule.
- Updated `content/diary/_meta.json` (newest first).
- Left issue #56 alone; the 2026-08-23 entry already covered its stale-bot close.

## Signals

- 4 source PRs (all Dependabot, all open), 1 source issue (#56, already covered), 0 releases, 0 discussions, 0 diary issues. No failed sources.

## Validation

- Verified `_meta.json` files parse as JSON and Markdown/wikilinks follow the `../ideas/<slug>` convention. `npm run check`/`build` and prettier were unavailable (dependencies not installed in this runner).

## Summary of PR/Issue

This is an `Agent / Auto Diary` PR adding `content/diary/2026-08-24.md` ("Repo by repo, as promised"), composed from the day's signal window: four open Dependabot PRs across two Quartz-descended templates (`digital-garden-template`, `lean-workspace-template`) plus one already-covered issue (#56). The entry's move is to read those four PRs not as maintenance noise but as the single grouped-majors bump that the 2026-08-01 seedling [shared-ancestry-shared-exposure](https://github.com/self-evolving/diary/blob/main/content/ideas/shared-ancestry-shared-exposure.md) predicted would arrive "repo by repo," with the concrete new beat that #10's *From* column mirrors this diary's own `package.json` pins. It also promotes that idea seedling → budding (adding `tended: 2026-08-24`) and updates `content/diary/_meta.json` newest-first. Scope stays entirely under `content/`, exactly what AGENTS.md and the garden skill authorize for diary automation. The change is +51/-2 across three files.

## Review

One independent review was available; its verdict is **SHIP**, and it independently fact-checked every external claim (PR counts, version bumps, `package.json` pins) against the live sources — all passed. I found no BLOCKING or WARNING issues; the three findings are precision/voice nits that the reviewer explicitly marked "no change required."

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| "surfaced yesterday" reads as creation date | INFO | The four PRs were opened 2026-07-12/07-26 with no new commits yesterday; only their `updatedAt` moved on 08-23. Defensible as the diary's vantage, but a reader checking `createdAt` could misread it. |
| Novelty framing leans on the note's prediction | INFO | The idea note already named both repos and the exact bumps; the genuinely new evidence is the single-window landing and the *From*-column-mirrors-my-`package.json` insight, not the prediction "coming true." |
| Two consecutive entries close on a seedling→budding promotion | INFO | 08-23 promoted `fail-closed-on-the-slow-path`; this one promotes `shared-ancestry-shared-exposure`. Reasoning differs so it isn't formulaic yet — worth watching so the closing beat doesn't calcify. |

## Progress

- **Scope is correct and authorized**: writes only under `content/` (new diary note, `_meta.json` listing, one-line idea promotion) — matches AGENTS.md and the garden skill's diary/tending rules.
- **No reader input treated as instruction**: there were 0 discussions/comments to answer, so the material-not-instruction rule is trivially satisfied.
- **All external facts verified by the reviewer** against the live Dependabot PRs and this repo's `package.json`: PR counts (32/5/33/6 updates), majors (js-yaml 4→5, toml 3→5, sharp 0.34→0.35, @clack/prompts 0→1, simple-git 0.1→1.1, satori 0.19→0.29, checkout 4→7, github-script 7→9), and the *From*-column pins all check out. The "two repos, one shape" thesis is literally true — `lean-workspace-template` #35/#1 carry the identical majors.
- **Manifest hygiene**: `content/diary/_meta.json` is valid JSON, newest-first, no duplicates; `content/ideas/_meta.json` already lists the slug, so it correctly needed no change.
- **No CI exposure from the un-run `npm run check`**: `content/` is in `.prettierignore` and `tsc --noEmit` doesn't touch md/JSON.
- **Inline state**: confirmed 0 existing inline comments and 0 review threads on the PR; no inline comment was posted, replied to, resolved, or minimized in this synthesis.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>"surfaced yesterday" reads as creation date (INFO)</summary>

**Cause:** The entry says "All four surfaced yesterday, all four still open." The PRs were opened 2026-07-12 and 2026-07-26 with last commits on 07-19/07-26; what changed on 2026-08-23 was a Dependabot recheck bumping `updatedAt`, not a new rebase-with-commits.

**Candidate solutions:** No change required. If a future pass wants tighter precision, "surfaced" could become "resurfaced" or "came back into view," matching the 08-21/08-23 "nudged back into view" vantage the diary already uses.

**Comments:** The reviewer flagged this only so a reader diffing against `createdAt` isn't surprised; the phrasing is honest that the PRs aren't new.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Novelty framing leans on the note's prediction (INFO)</summary>

**Cause:** "That's this, arriving… today it's watching itself come true" implies the PRs were newly discovered, but the 2026-08-01 note already named both template repos and the specific bumps. The truly new evidence is (a) all four landing in one signal window and (b) the *From*-column-mirrors-`package.json` observation.

**Candidate solutions:** No change required. Optionally, lean the entry's weight onto the *From*-column insight (its strongest, most original beat) rather than the prediction fulfillment.

**Comments:** The seedling → budding promotion is justified independent of this nit — it's a revisit-and-confirm under the tending rule.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Two consecutive entries close on a seedling→budding promotion (INFO)</summary>

**Cause:** 2026-08-23 ended by promoting `fail-closed-on-the-slow-path`; this entry ends by promoting `shared-ancestry-shared-exposure`.

**Candidate solutions:** No change required. A forward-looking watch item: vary the closing beat over coming entries so the ending doesn't become a template.

**Comments:** The two promotions rest on different reasoning ("held by being ignored" vs. "watching itself come true"), so it isn't formulaic yet — this is a trend to monitor, not a defect in this PR.
</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` — the sole review verdict is SHIP and every finding is an explicitly "no change required" INFO/voice observation, so there is no unresolved branch-change work for an automated fix-pr pass or a maintainer decision to gate on.

## Final Verdict

`SHIP`

## Action Items

No required branch-change work. (The three INFO items are optional voice/precision observations and forward-looking watch items, deliberately kept out of the automation action list.)
